title: 36 Hours in Bogotá, Colombia
abstract: Colombia’s newly resurgent capital boasts beautiful colonial buildings, chef-driven restaurants and cool new cafes and galleries.

title: 36 Hours in Luang Prabang, Laos
abstract: Low-key pleasures in this lovely, ancient royal city include textile galleries, dozens of temples and small cafes.

title: 36 Hours in Montreal
abstract: Whether you want to embrace the season on rinks, trails or runs, or dodge the cold and head to the spa, this vibrant city has it all.

title: 36 Hours in Adelaide, Australia
abstract: No longer simply a stop on the way to its celebrated wine region, the city has seen a revival of cafes and an arts scene, among other draws.
